title: private-deployment-vanguard-weekly-sync-2026-10-19
content:
Vanguard private deployment weekly sync - 2026-10-19
Owners: Asha (Redwood: SE lead), Miguel (Redwood: infra eng), Sofia (Redwood: SRE), Michael Chen (Vanguard: infra lead)
Location: Zoom / notes in Drive
Status: mid-rollout - staging validated, starting gradual prod cutover next week if no regressions

Agenda:
- Quick status (5m)
- Staging validation results and outstanding items (10m)
- Network / VPC peering & egress firewall blockers (10m)
- Deployment runbook updates and canary schedule for prod (10m)
- Action items / owners (10m)

Attendees (present): Asha, Miguel, Sofia, Ben, Elena, Michael Chen
Attendees (absent): N/A

Notes / Decisions:
- Staging validation: most integration tests passed. Two flaky tests remain (auth token refresh and rate-limit handling) - test flakes reproducible in >1% of runs. Risk low but needs fix before full prod cutover. (Owner: Ben)
- Performance baseline: 99th pct latency on staging with 16-token context is within SLO for GPU pool A. Will re-run with 128-token workload next Tue to validate kernel selection. (Owner: Miguel)
- VPC peering: Vanguard's net team updated routes; however egress firewall blocks POST to our metrics ingestion endpoint from one subnet (10.24.18.0/24). Vanguard network says rule change scheduled Fri 10/22. Temporary workaround: route metrics from that subnet to a proxy (Sofia to deploy).
- KMS integration: Vanguard requested HSM-backed key usage for encrypting KV cache snapshots. Product/legal review in progress; need to confirm SLA impact and cost delta. (Owner: Elena to follow up with security/compliance)
- Runbook: Added explicit rollback checkpoint after canary stage; agreed on 30-minute observation window per canary batch. Canary schedule drafted - starts 10/26 if blockers cleared.

Open Blockers:
- AUTH-FLAKE: token refresh test failing intermittently - cause: race where refresh thread and session invalidation collide. Repro steps in linked PR. Mitigation: increase token TTL to reduce refresh frequency; long-term fix requires locking around session update. (Owner: Ben; ETA patch v1: 2026-10-21)
- METRICS-EGRESS: firewall rule blocking metrics from 10.24.18.0/24 - Vanguard change ticket created (VANG-NET-79). Temporary proxy route needed; SRE to stand up proxy by 2026-10-20. (Owner: Sofia; ETA: 2026-10-20)
- HSM/KEYS: legal + security review for HSM use pending - need estimated cost and expected latency impact for KV snapshot encryption. (Owner: Elena; ETA initial update: 2026-10-23)

Milestones / Timeline (high level):
- 2026-10-21: Fix AUTH-FLAKE patch deployed to staging; re-run flaky tests
- 2026-10-22: Vanguard apply egress firewall change OR SRE proxy in place
- 2026-10-23: Security/legal update on HSM integration and cost implications
- 2026-10-26: Canary prod cutover (batch 1) - target 10% traffic, 30m observation window
- 2026-11-02: Full prod rollout (if canary stable across 72h)

Action items (clear owners + due dates):
- Ben: implement AUTH-FLAKE patch + open PR with tests and repro case (due 2026-10-21)
- Miguel: run perf baseline with 128-token context on staging and share results (due 2026-10-20)
- Sofia: stand up temporary metrics proxy (k8s service in Vanguard VPC) and validate ingestion from affected subnet (due 2026-10-20)
- Elena: collect HSM cost/latency estimates, coordinate with legal for SLA language, and summarize options (due 2026-10-23)
- Asha: finalize canary schedule & update deployment runbook with rollback steps, notify Vanguard ops (due 2026-10-22)
- Michael (Vanguard): confirm VANG-NET-79 ETA and notify if timeline slips (due 2026-10-20)

Risks / Notes to self:
- If AUTH-FLAKE fix delays beyond 10/21, move canary to 11/02 and communicate to Vanguard.
- HSM decision could add 2-4 days to rollout if procurement/legal require contract amendment. Need contingency plan: proceed with KMS (non-HSM) for initial rollout and migrate later if acceptable to Vanguard. Document pros/cons in runbook.

Follow-up: next sync Mon 2026-10-26 (canary day) - short check-in 09:00 PT to confirm green on pre-cutover checks.

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PD/Vanguard+Deployment+Runbook
- Jira: PLAT-4820 (canary automation), VANG-NET-79 (Vanguard firewall change)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/pd-vanguard/pull/34 (AUTH-FLAKE repro & fix)
